label: urban-centres
_why: Urban centres are the largest remaining block of scenario error after the consumption fit (FINDINGS F15): services and transportation together are a fifth of what is left, and both are urban-centre goods. Two unknowns: which production methods those levels actually run (the extractor currently guesses from the market leader's laws), and whether feeding military buildings into the urbanization sum closes the 25-30% level shortfall. This run measures the active PMs of every urban centre in the world, plus a fresh inventory and Feb order book to re-fit against.
